title: HTTP API / backend service
description: Backend service or public API without a UI.

steps.title: Brief
steps.acceptance: Endpoints or events, request/response shapes, auth model, error format, limits and repo are in the brief.

steps.title: Contract
steps.acceptance: OpenAPI or typed route definitions written first and agreed in the task.

steps.title: Build
steps.acceptance: Implementation matches the contract; Drizzle migrations; integration tests against a real Postgres.

steps.title: Code review
steps.acceptance: Diff within scope; consistent error format; no `any`; idempotency where the contract says so.

steps.title: Security gate
steps.acceptance: Every item of SECURITY RULES checked and reported pass/fail with file references.

steps.title: Contract tests
steps.acceptance: Tests exercise success, validation error, unauthenticated and forbidden cases for each endpoint.

security_rules: No secrets, tokens or `.env` content in code, commits, logs or screenshots.
Dependencies: pin versions, run the audit (`npm audit --omit=dev`), no new package without a stated reason.
Every endpoint authenticated unless explicitly listed as public; authorisation checked per resource.
Validate body, query and params with schemas; reject unknown fields; size limits on bodies.
Parametrised queries only (Drizzle); no string-built SQL.
Rate limiting and request timeouts; pagination caps on list endpoints.
CORS allow-list, not `*`, for credentialed requests.
Errors return a stable JSON shape without stack traces or internal ids; log with request id, never with secrets or PII.
Webhooks verify signatures with constant-time comparison; tokens compared in constant time.
tech_stack: Postgres + Drizzle ORM with versioned migrations
node:test or Vitest for unit/integration tests
